headline: KCR @ TEX matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is KCR 4.22 at TEX 4.83, with a projected total of 9.04. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward KCR: KCR moved +0.60 runs while TEX moved +0.23, changing the projected margin by +0.37 runs. The projected total climbed +0.83, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -12.4%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Kumar Rocker has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Josh Jung, Maikel Garcia, Bobby Witt Jr., based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Danny Jansen, Kyle Isbel because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
